title: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
scope: The Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp’s historic exterior, including monumental entrance, twin bronze chariots, long exhibition wings and the present rooftop daylight structures.
limitations: Street-side volumes and courtyard roof follow the present footprint, archival façade and current published roof description. Small sculptures, inscriptions, patina and roof glazing detail are representative.
The surface survey predates the 2022 reopening, so modern rooflight height and exact glass panels are estimated.
